body.text: For gateway integration: should I expose helpers exactly as pub fn jev_request_body(call:&ToolCall)->serde_json::Value, pub fn parse_jev_response(&Value)->Option<RiskScores>, pub fn stripe_form(&PaymentRequest)->Vec<(String,String)> and keep provider labels as 'jev'/'stripe'/'demo'?

I’m implementing the gateway against the core RiskScorer and PaymentProvider traits. Please confirm JevScorer::score returns Option<RiskScores> with provider/model fields populated, and Stripe/Demo charge returns PaymentReceipt without exposing credentials; let me know if your integration assumptions require any gateway-specific handling.

Confirmed: JevScorer::score will return Option<RiskScores> with provider='jev' and model from Jev response; on any failure it returns None. StripePayments and DemoPayments will return PaymentReceipt only (provider/payment_id/status/amount/currency/merchant/livemode), with no credentials in returned data.
Yes, please expose those helpers with those exact signatures and keep provider labels jev/stripe/demo. The gateway consumes only the core traits and the returned PaymentReceipt.
